questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` adinda login role olustur ve owner'i bu rol olan `app` database'ini ac.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "CREATE ROLE app_user WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'app_user_pw2026';"
steps.hint_text: Login role olustururken CREATE ROLE ve WITH LOGIN PASSWORD kullan.

steps.answer: createdb -U postgres -O app_user app
steps.hint_text: Owner belirleyerek database acmak icin createdb -O kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` rolune `app` database'i icin CONNECT izni ver.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE app TO app_user;"
steps.hint_text: Database baglanti izni icin GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` rolune `app` icindeki public schema icin USAGE izni ver.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_user;"
steps.hint_text: Schema kullanimi icin GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA komutunu kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` rolune `app` icindeki mevcut tum tablolarda SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ve DELETE izni ver.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user;"
steps.hint_text: Tum mevcut tablolar icin ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public uzerinden grant ver.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` rolune `app` icindeki mevcut tum sequence'lerde USAGE, SELECT ve UPDATE izni ver.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "GRANT USAGE, SELECT, UPDATE ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user;"
steps.hint_text: Sequence yetkileri icin ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public kalibini kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda bundan sonra olusacak tum tablolar icin `app_user` rolune varsayilan SELECT izni tanimla.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO app_user;"
steps.hint_text: Gelecekte olusacak tablolar icin ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'inde `pgcrypto` extension'ini kur.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";"
steps.hint_text: Extension kurulumu icin CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'inde `users` tablosunun toplam boyutunu insan okunur formatta goster.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size('users'));"
steps.hint_text: Tablo boyutu icin pg_total_relation_size ve pg_size_pretty birlikte kullanilir.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'inin toplam boyutunu insan okunur formatta goster.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size('app'));"
steps.hint_text: Database boyutu icin pg_database_size kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'inde `users` tablosu icin tanimli index isimlerini listele.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'users' ORDER BY indexname;"
steps.hint_text: Tablo index'lerini gormek icin pg_indexes view'unu kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `users` tablosunda `status = pending` filtresi icin query planini goster.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = 'pending';"
steps.hint_text: Calistirmadan plan gormek icin EXPLAIN kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `users` tablosunda `status = pending` filtresini gercek kosuyla analiz et.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM users WHERE status = 'pending';"
steps.hint_text: Gercek calisma maliyeti icin EXPLAIN ANALYZE kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda planner istatistiklerini guncellemek icin `users` tablosunu ANALYZE et.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "ANALYZE users;"
steps.hint_text: Tablo istatistigi yenilemek icin ANALYZE kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `users` tablosu uzerinde VACUUM ANALYZE calistir.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "VACUUM ANALYZE users;"
steps.hint_text: Bakim ve istatistik icin VACUUM ANALYZE kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'inin custom format backup'ini `app.dump` dosyasina al.

steps.answer: pg_dump -U postgres -Fc app -f app.dump
steps.hint_text: Custom dump icin pg_dump'i -Fc ile calistir.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app.dump` dump dosyasini `app` database'ine clean restore et.

steps.answer: pg_restore -U postgres -d app --clean --if-exists app.dump
steps.hint_text: Temiz restore icin pg_restore'u --clean ve --if-exists ile calistir.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app` database'indeki idle session'lari sonlandir.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'app' AND state = 'idle';"
steps.hint_text: Idle session kapatmak icin pg_stat_activity ve pg_terminate_backend kullan.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `users` tablosu uzerindeki relation lock ayrintilarini listele.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "SELECT locktype, mode, granted FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = l.relation WHERE c.relname = 'users';"
steps.hint_text: Belirli bir tablo lock'unu gormek icin pg_locks ile pg_class join'i yap.

questions.scenario: Gece vardiyasinda `app_user` rolune `app` icin 5s statement timeout ata.

steps.answer: psql -U postgres -d app -c "ALTER ROLE app_user IN DATABASE app SET statement_timeout = '5s';"
steps.hint_text: Role ve database bazli ayar icin ALTER ROLE ... IN DATABASE ... SET kullan.
